place.name: Verno
place.description: Verno (Greek: Βέρνο), Vitsi (Greek: Βίτσι) or Vicho (Macedonian: Вичо) is a forested mountain range in the southern part of the Florina and the northeastern part of the Kastoria regional units in Western Macedonia, northern Greece. The elevation of its highest peak is 2,128 m (6,982 ft).
